SELECT 
  fished_date_doy,
  SUM(yt) as total_yt,
  COUNT(DISTINCT boat) as num_boats,
  COUNT(*) as num_trips,
  ROUND(SUM(yt)::float / COUNT(*), 2) as avg_yt_per_trip
FROM trips
WHERE fished_date_season = 2 AND fished_date_doy >= 152
GROUP BY fished_date_doy
ORDER BY fished_date_doy
